---
title: Mattermost
description: Privacy rules for Mattermost 10.11 to 12.1 on PostgreSQL, and 10.11 on MySQL
---

Covers Mattermost users' e-mail addresses, names, usernames, IP addresses, password hashes, session, OAuth, and integration secrets, and message content.

## Coverage

- **Versions:** 10.11 ESR to 12.1.
- **Engines:** PostgreSQL; MySQL on 10.11 only (11.0 removed it).
- **Table prefix:** the template assumes unprefixed table names. Mattermost uses no table prefix.

## Template

<Tabs groupId="mattermost-version" persist items={['10.11', '11.0–11.2', '11.3–11.7', '11.8', '11.9–12.1']} defaultIndex={4}>
<Tab value="10.11">

```yaml
privacy:
  rules:
    emails:
      columns:
        - users.email
        - teams.email
        - compliances.emails
      entity: EMAIL_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    names:
      columns:
        - users.username
        - users.firstname
        - users.lastname
        - users.nickname
        - users.authdata
        - outgoingoauthconnections.credentialsusername
      entity: PERSON
      operator: hash
    ip-addresses:
      columns:
        - audits.ipaddress
      entity: IP_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    text:
      columns:
        # Message content (optional)
        - posts.message
        - posts.props
        - drafts.message
        - drafts.props
        - scheduledposts.message
        - scheduledposts.props
        - fileinfo.content
      entity: PERSON
      operator: replace
    passwords:
      columns:
        - users.password
      entity: PASSWORD_HASH
      operator: redact
    secrets:
      columns:
        - users.mfasecret
        - sessions.token
        - sessions.deviceid
        - useraccesstokens.token
        - tokens.token
        - desktoptokens.token
        - oauthaccessdata.token
        - oauthaccessdata.refreshtoken
        - oauthauthdata.code
        - oauthapps.clientsecret
        - outgoingoauthconnections.clientsecret
        - outgoingoauthconnections.credentialspassword
        - remoteclusters.token
        - remoteclusters.remotetoken
        - commands.token
        - outgoingwebhooks.token
        - teams.inviteid
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:
      columns:
        - users.props
        - users.notifyprops
        - users.timezone
        - sessions.props
        - tokens.extra
        - audits.extrainfo
        - pluginkeyvaluestore.pvalue
      entity: PERSON
      operator: replace
```

**Choices**

- `users.authdata` is the user's id at the SSO provider, often the e-mail address under SAML: hashed as `PERSON`.
- `teams.inviteid` makes up the team invite link; `sessions.deviceid` (and `voipdeviceid`, 11.9+) holds mobile push tokens.
- `pluginkeyvaluestore.pvalue` can hold per-user plugin credentials; dropping `mixed-content` exposes them.
- Optional parts: delete the commented message-content columns if the assistant should read posts, and the `mixed-content` rule if it needs those columns readable.

## Trade-offs

- **Indexed ruled columns:** `users.email`, `username`, `authdata`, `nickname`, `firstname`, `lastname`; `useraccesstokens.token`; `tokens.token`; `desktoptokens.token`; `oauthaccessdata.token`, `refreshtoken`; `oauthauthdata.code`; `sessions.token`; `teams.inviteid`; `posts.message`, `fileinfo.content` (message content).
- **Lookups that stop working:** users by e-mail, username, or name; audit rows by IP; sessions, access tokens, or invites by token; with message content, post search by text.
- **Join keys that stay unruled:** `users.id` and every `userid`, `audits.sessionid`, `oauthaccessdata.clientid`, `remoteclusters.remoteid`.

## Not covered

- `incomingwebhooks.id`: the webhook URL's secret, and the table's key.
- `channels.displayname`, `publicchannels.displayname` of group messages: members' usernames.
- `propertyvalues.value`, `recentsearches.query`: custom profile attributes and users' search terms.
- `preferences.value`, `channelmembers.notifyprops`, `jobs.data`, `linkmetadata.data`, `views.props`: settings, job parameters, link previews.
- `fileinfo.name`, `path`, `uploadsessions.filename`: file names that name people.
- Plugin tables (Playbooks `ir_*`, Boards, Calls): created by each plugin.
